items.headline: Iran and Oman Near Deal on Strait of Hormuz Traffic as Oil Prices Rise
items.summary: Iranian officials stated on August 6 that a developing maritime agreement with Oman will not fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz to unrestricted international transit [2.2.4]. The statement caused global crude oil prices to surge, making the diplomatic talks a central market-moving issue as nations negotiate control over the strategic shipping passage.

items.headline: Astros Star Yordan Alvarez Tops MLB Hitter Rankings Amid Triple Crown Pursuit
items.summary: Major League Baseball published its latest hitter power rankings on August 6, with Houston Astros slugger Yordan Alvarez retaining the top spot [3.2.2]. Alvarez currently leads the American League in batting average, home runs, and RBIs as he aims to become baseball's first Triple Crown winner since 2012.

items.headline: Michelle Yeoh Named Asian Filmmaker of the Year for 31st Busan International Film Festival
items.summary: Oscar-winning actor Michelle Yeoh was named Asian Filmmaker of the Year for the 31st Busan International Film Festival on August 6 [3.3.3]. She will accept the prestigious honor in person during the festival's opening ceremony in October, marking her first visit to the South Korean event in 15 years.
